theme: Quiet Shore — Pebble Cove at Dusk
title: Quiet Shore at Dusk | 1 Hour of Real Coastal Sounds
description:
A warm-windowed shore hut, clear water over pebbles and the last light on an open horizon. Quiet Shore pairs this fictional, AI-created coastal scene and subtle water animation with an hour-long arrangement of real stereo field recordings from Whitby, De Haan and Dunwich.

Long, unrepeated source passages and gentle transitions leave room for the natural movement and texture of the water. Settle in for reading, winding down, or a quiet pause at the coast. Recording attribution and changes are listed below.

The coastal scene and thumbnail are AI-generated, with added water animation. The pictured cove is fictional; the recordings retain the locations and recordists credited above.
